    middle_col = w // 2
    if w % 2 == 1 and all(grid[r][middle_col] == grid[0][middle_col] for r in range(h)):
        return [[2 if grid[r][c] and grid[r][c + middle_col + 1] else 0 for c in range(middle_col)] for r in range(h)]

'''
